title: Toddalolactone inhibits the activation of fibroblasts in skin fibrosis by regulating MAOA.
authors: Wang, Yongping; Li, Shimeng; Song, Hao; Yang, Cheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Toddalolactone通过抑制MAOA调控TGF-beta1通路缓解皮肤纤维化，仅涉及分子对接初步预测靶点，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Skin fibrosis is characterized by excessive deposition of extracellular matrix driven by activated fibroblasts, leading to varying degrees of patient discomfort, deformity, disability, and even death. In vitro studies using mouse primary skin fibroblasts (PSFs) and patient-derived primary keloid fibroblasts (KFs) demonstrated that toddalolactone (Tod) significantly inhibited fibroblast proliferation, migration, and activation and suppressed the TGF-beta1/Smad and TGF-beta1/non-Smad pathways in these cells. In a bleomycin (BLM)-induced mouse model of skin fibrosis, Tod treatment significantly reduced dermal thickness and collagen deposition in mouse skin, decreased skin hydroxyproline content, and inhibited fibroblast activation as well as the TGF-beta1/Smad and TGF-beta1/non-Smad pathways in vivo. In a keloid xenograft mouse model, Tod treatment significantly reduced the relative weight of keloids in mice. Histopathological analysis revealed that Tod alleviated the degree of keloid fibrosis and collagen aggregation while inhibiting fibroblast activation in keloid tissue. Furthermore, molecular docking identified monoamine oxidase A (MAOA) as a potential target of Tod. Cellular thermal shift assays and MAOA knockdown using siRNA in PSFs and KFs demonstrated that Tod inhibits the TGF-beta1 pathway and suppresses fibroblast activation by inhibiting MAOA. Collectively, the findings reveal that Tod regulates the TGF-beta1/Smad and TGF-beta1/non-Smad pathways through inhibiting MAOA, thereby affecting skin fibroblast activation and alleviating skin fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 皮肤纤维化以活化成纤维细胞驱动的细胞外基质过度沉积为特征，导致患者出现不同程度的不适、畸形、残疾甚至死亡。使用小鼠原代皮肤成纤维细胞（PSFs）和患者来源的原代瘢痕疙瘩成纤维细胞（KFs）进行的体外研究表明，托达洛内酯（Tod）显著抑制了这些细胞中成纤维细胞的增殖、迁移和活化，并抑制了TGF-beta1/Smad和TGF-beta1/non-Smad通路。在博来霉素（BLM）诱导的小鼠皮肤纤维化模型中，Tod治疗显著减少了小鼠皮肤的皮肤厚度和胶原沉积，降低了皮肤羟脯氨酸含量，并在体内抑制了成纤维细胞活化以及TGF-beta1/Smad和TGF-beta1/non-Smad通路。在瘢痕疙瘩异种移植小鼠模型中，Tod治疗显著降低了小鼠瘢痕疙瘩的相对重量。组织病理学分析显示，Tod减轻了瘢痕疙瘩纤维化和胶原聚集的程度，同时抑制了瘢痕疙瘩组织中成纤维细胞的活化。此外，分子对接鉴定出单胺氧化酶A（MAOA）为Tod的潜在靶点。细胞热位移实验和在PSFs及KFs中使用siRNA敲低MAOA的实验表明，Tod通过抑制MAOA来抑制TGF-beta1通路并抑制成纤维细胞活化。总体而言，这些发现揭示Tod通过抑制MAOA调节TGF-beta1/Smad和TGF-beta1/non-Smad通路，从而影响皮肤成纤维细胞活化并缓解皮肤纤维化。
